//@version=6
indicator("Volume Bubbles", overlay = true)

// --- Inputs ---
int lookbackInput = input.int(20, "Volume Lookback Length", tooltip = "Used to calculate relative volume")
color upColor     = input.color(color.new(#089981, 40), "Up Volume Color", group = "Style")
color downColor   = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 40), "Down Volume Color", group = "Style")
string posInput   = input.string("hl2", "Bubble Position", options = ["close", "hl2", "high", "low"], group = "Style")

// --- Calculations ---
// Find max and min volume over the lookback period to normalize
float maxVol = ta.highest(volume, lookbackInput)
float minVol = ta.lowest(volume, lookbackInput)

// Normalize volume to a 0-1 scale
float normVol = maxVol != minVol ? (volume - minVol) / (maxVol - minVol) : 0

// Calculate bubble size (1 to 15)
int bubbleSize = math.max(1, math.round(normVol * 15))

// Determine the position for the bubbles
float bubblePos = switch posInput
    "close" => close
    "high"  => high
    "low"   => low
    => hl2

// Determine the color based on price direction
color bubbleColor = close >= open ? upColor : downColor

// --- Plotting ---
// Since `plot` does not support a dynamic (series) linewidth, we use conditional plots
plot(bubbleSize == 1 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 1", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 1)
plot(bubbleSize == 2 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 2", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 2)
plot(bubbleSize == 3 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 3", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 3)
plot(bubbleSize == 4 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 4", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 4)
plot(bubbleSize == 5 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 5", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 5)
plot(bubbleSize == 6 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 6", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 6)
plot(bubbleSize == 7 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 7", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 7)
plot(bubbleSize == 8 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 8", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 8)
plot(bubbleSize == 9 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 9", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 9)
plot(bubbleSize == 10 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 10", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 10)
plot(bubbleSize == 11 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 11", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 11)
plot(bubbleSize == 12 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 12", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 12)
plot(bubbleSize == 13 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 13", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 13)
plot(bubbleSize == 14 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 14", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 14)
plot(bubbleSize >= 15 ? bubblePos : na, "Size 15+", color = bubbleColor, style = plot.style_circles, linewidth = 15)
